args.command: cd /root/nanobot-src && git log --oneline -5 && echo "---" && git status --short
ps aux | grep -E 'hermes|deepseek' | grep -v grep
grep -n 'model or self.agents.defaults.model\|if not model: return None' /root/nanobot-src/nanobot/config/schema.py

tail -100 /root/nanobot-src/nanobot/logs/gateway.log 2>/dev/null || journalctl -u nanobot --no-pager -n 50 2>/dev/null || echo "no gateway log found, trying other paths..." && find /root/nanobot-src -name "*.log" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10

# 找 deepseektui
find /root -maxdepth 3 -name "deepseek*" -o -name "DeepSeek*" 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "==="
# 找 hermesagent
find /root -maxdepth 3 -name "hermes*" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -10
sed -n '185,200p' /root/nanobot-src/nanobot/config/schema.py
tail -50 /root/nanobot-src/.git/config-versions.git/gateway_new.log 2>/dev/null

# 检查 deepseek-tui 是什么、怎么启动
file /root/.local/bin/deepseek-tui
echo "==="
/root/.local/bin/deepseek-tui --help 2>&1 | head -20

# 找 nanobot gateway 实际日志
find /root/.nanobot -name "*.log" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10
echo "==="
# 检查 gateway 进程的输出
ls -la /proc/3085222/fd/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'log|txt|out'
echo "==="
# 检查是否有 openrouter 相关日志
find /root -maxdepth 4 -name "*openrouter*" -o -name "*litellm*" -o -name "*request*log*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '.git' | head -10

# 检查 hermes_cli 是否正常运行
systemctl --user status hermes-cli 2>/dev/null || echo "no systemd user service"
echo "==="
# 检查 hermes_cli 日志
journalctl --user -u hermes-cli --no-pager -n 10 2>/dev/null || echo "no journal"
echo "==="
# 检查 deepseek-tui 是否有 systemd 服务
systemctl --user list-units --all 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'deepseek|hermes' || echo "no matching user units"
systemctl list-units --all 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'deepseek|hermes' || echo "no matching system units"

# 查看 gateway 进程的 stderr/stdout 重定向到哪里
cat /proc/3085222/fd/1 2>/dev/null | tail -30 || echo "cannot read fd/1"
echo "==="
ls -la /proc/3085222/fd/ 2>/dev/null
tail -50 /root/.nanobot/gateway.log 2>/dev/null
ls -la /root/.nanobot/request_logs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "===" && tail -30 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/*.log 2>/dev/null | tail -50

# 检查 hermes-gateway 服务状态
systemctl status hermes-gateway --no-pager 2>/dev/null
echo "==="
# 检查 deepseek-tui 怎么启动 - 看看有没有 tmux session 或启动脚本
tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null || echo "no tmux sessions"
echo "==="
# 看看 deepseek-tui 的 exec 模式
/root/.local/bin/deepseek-tui exec --help 2>&1 | head -20

# 拉取今天最新的 openrouter 请求日志
tail -20 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        d = json.loads(line.strip())
        ts = d.get('timestamp','')[:19]
        model = d.get('model','?')
        status = 'ok' if d.get('response') else 'error'
        err = d.get('error','')
        print(f'{ts} | {model} | {status}' + (f' | {err[:80]}' if err else ''))
    except: pass
" 2>/dev/null

# 检查 gateway 进程是否还活着
ps aux | grep 'nanobot gateway' | grep -v grep
echo "==="
# 检查 gateway 端口
ss -tlnp | grep 18790

# 检查 hermes-gateway 系统服务
systemctl status hermes-gateway --no-pager -l 2>&1 | head -20
echo "==="
# 启动 deepseek-tui 在 tmux 中
which tmux 2>/dev/null && echo "tmux available" || echo "no tmux"

# 拉取详细错误信息
tail -20 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        d = json.loads(line.strip())
        ts = d.get('timestamp','')[:19] if d.get('timestamp') else '?'
        model = d.get('model','?')
        err = d.get('error','')
        err_type = d.get('error_type','')
        print(f'{ts} | {model} | {err_type} | {err[:120]}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'parse error: {e}')
" 2>/dev/null

# 检查 gateway 实际监听状态
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E '18790|python'
echo "==="
# 检查 gateway 进程健康
curl -s http://localhost:18790/health 2>&1 || echo "health check failed"
echo "==="
# 检查最新日志中的错误趋势
tail -200 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
from collections import Counter
errors = Counter()
models = Counter()
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        d = json.loads(line.strip())
        m = d.get('model','?')
        if d.get('error'):
            errors[m] += 1
        else:
            models[m] += 1
    except: pass
print('=== Errors ===')
for k,v in errors.most_common():
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')
print(f'Total errors: {sum(errors.values())}')
print('=== OK ===')
for k,v in models.most_common():
    print(f'  {k}: {v}')
print(f'Total ok: {sum(models.values())}')
" 2>/dev/null

# 检查 hermes 进程和 deepseek-tui 启动
ps aux | grep -E 'hermes|deepseek' | grep -v grep
echo "==="
# 在 tmux 中启动 deepseek-tui
tmux new-session -d -s deepseek-tui '/root/.local/bin/deepseek-tui 2>&1' 2>&1 && echo "deepseek-tui started in tmux" || echo "failed to start deepseek-tui"

tail -5 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    d = json.loads(line.strip())
    print(json.dumps(d, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)[:500])
    print('---')
"

# 检查 gateway 是否真的在处理请求 - 通过查看日志文件更新时间
stat /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl
echo "==="
# 检查最后一条成功请求
grep -v '"error"' /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | tail -3 | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    d = json.loads(line.strip())
    print(d.get('timestamp','?')[:19], d.get('model','?'))
"

# 验证 deepseek-tui 是否在运行
tmux capture-pane -t deepseek-tui -p 2>/dev/null | head -20

tail -3 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    d = json.loads(line.strip())
    # show all top-level keys
    print('Keys:', list(d.keys()))
    # check for error/response
    if 'error' in d:
        print('error:', str(d['error'])[:200])
    if 'response' in d:
        print('response:', str(d['response'])[:200])
    if 'status' in d:
        print('status:', d['status'])
    print('---')
"

# 统计今天的请求状态
python3 -c "
import json
from collections import Counter
total = 0
errors = 0
oks = 0
error_types = Counter()
with open('/root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        total += 1
        d = json.loads(line.strip())
        if d.get('error'):
            errors += 1
            error_types[str(d['error'])[:80]] += 1
        else:
            oks += 1
print(f'Total: {total}, OK: {oks}, Errors: {errors}')
print(f'Error rate: {errors/total*100:.1f}%' if total else '')
print()
print('Top error types:')
for err, cnt in error_types.most_common(5):
    print(f'  [{cnt}] {err}')
"

# 检查 gateway.log 中的 ModuleNotFoundError 是当前进程还是旧日志
head -5 /root/.nanobot/gateway.log 2>/dev/null
echo "==="
# 检查 gateway_new.log
tail -20 /root/.nanobot/gateway_new.log 2>/dev/null

# 让 deepseek-tui 跳过欢迎界面
tmux send-keys -t deepseek-tui Enter
sleep 1
tmux capture-pane -t deepseek-tui -p 2>/dev/null | tail -20

# 检查 hermes 健康状态 - 看最近日志
journalctl -u hermes-gateway --no-pager -n 5 2>/dev/null || echo "no system journal"
echo "==="
# 检查 hermes_cli 进程是否正常响应
ps -p 3137470 -o pid,etime,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null

# 完成 deepseek-tui 初始化设置 - 连续发送 Enter 跳过所有步骤
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    tmux send-keys -t deepseek-tui Enter
    sleep 0.5
done
sleep 1
tmux capture-pane -t deepseek-tui -p 2>/dev/null | tail -15

# 统计今天的 openrouter 请求摘要
python3 -c "
import json
from collections import Counter
total = 0
oks = 0
errors = 0
models = Counter()
error_models = Counter()
with open('/root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        total += 1
        d = json.loads(line.strip())
        m = d.get('model','?')
        if d.get('error'):
            errors += 1
            error_models[m] += 1
        else:
            oks += 1
            models[m] += 1

print(f'=== OpenRouter 今日 ({total} 请求) ===')
print(f'成功: {oks} ({oks/total*100:.1f}%) | 失败: {errors} ({errors/total*100:.1f}%)')
print()
print('--- 成功请求模型分布 ---')
for m, c in models.most_common():
    print(f'  {m}: {c} ({c/total*100:.1f}%)')
print()
print('--- 失败请求模型分布 ---')
for m, c in error_models.most_common():
    print(f'  {m}: {c}')
"

# 检查 gateway 进程是否正常 - 看最近一次成功请求的时间
tail -1 /root/.nanobot/request_logs/2026-05-15.jsonl | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
print(f'时间: {d[\"ts\"]}')
print(f'模型: {d[\"model\"]}')
print(f'状态: {d[\"status\"]}')
print(f'延迟: {d.get(\"latency\",\"?\")}s')
print(f'Agent: {d[\"agent\"]}')
print(f'回复长度: {d.get(\"reply_len\",\"?\")} 字')
"

import json

key = ds.get('key','')
print(f'key: {repr(key)}')

sleep 1
tmux capture-pane -t deepseek-tui -p
